title: Frogs to Indev Ranas
description: Adds Indev Ranas when using a name tag!
body:
# Overview
This is a simple resource pack that when using a Name Tag named "Rana" on a frog turns it into the Indev 0.31 Rana! Its also available in Cold and Warm types!
# Requirements
Requires [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads) to make the Indev Ranas work!
# Why you want to download this pack
If you are an Indev player and liked Ranas, this is for you!
